name: Shammua
overview: Shammua is identified in Scripture primarily as the representative of the tribe of Reuben among the twelve spies sent into Canaan, highlighting his role in Israel's exploration of the Promised Land. Additionally, Shammua is noted as a Levite and father of Abda, linking him to the priestly lineage involved in worship and thanksgiving, as seen in Nehemiah. His association with priestly duties underscores the multifaceted roles individuals named Shammua held within Israel's spiritual and communal life.
